spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Technical, grid-based, spacious but information-dense in sidebars. The center column breathes, the sidebars command.
spacing_and_layout.app_layout: h-screen w-screen flex overflow-hidden bg-[#09090B] text-[#FAFAFA] font-sans selection:bg-[#FFB340]/30
spacing_and_layout.left_sidebar: w-[260px] border-r border-[#27272A] bg-[#121214] flex flex-col hidden md:flex shrink-0
spacing_and_layout.main_chat: flex-1 flex flex-col h-full relative overflow-hidden
spacing_and_layout.right_sidebar: w-[320px] border-l border-[#27272A] bg-[#121214] overflow-y-auto hidden lg:flex flex-col shrink-0
spacing_and_layout.chat_container: max-w-3xl mx-auto w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-32

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#18181B] border border-[#27272A] hover:bg-[#27272A] text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

citations.inline: inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-[20px] h-5 rounded-sm bg-[#FFB340]/20 text-[#FFB340] text-xs font-mono border border-[#FFB340]/30 hover:bg-[#FFB340] hover:text-[#422006] transition-colors cursor-pointer px-1 mx-1
citations.card: p-4 rounded-lg bg-[#18181B] border border-[#27272A] hover:border-[#FFB340]/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,179,64,0.05)] transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col gap-2 relative overflow-hidden

chat_bubbles.user: bg-[#18181B] border border-[#27272A] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-5 text-[#FAFAFA] max-w-[85%] self-end shadow-sm

inputs.chat_bar: bg-[#18181B] border border-[#27272A] rounded-xl focus-within:border-zinc-500 focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-zinc-500 transition-all shadow-lg

motion.list_stagger: Use Framer Motion `staggerChildren: 0.05` for chat history and document lists
motion.fade_in_up: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements MUST include a role-based kebab-case data-testid (e.g., data-testid='new-chat-btn', data-testid='upload-pdf-dropzone', data-testid='citation-chip-1')

empty_state_graphic.description: Abstract minimalist 3D geometric composition for the empty chat state

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Zustand. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx), use JavaScript (.jsx/.js).
App is a high-end AI research SaaS. Avoid 'cartoonish' looks, overly bright colors, or purple-violet gradients. Stick strictly to the Obsidian and Amber color palette.
Implement a 3-column layout: Left (Nav/History), Center (Chat), Right (Context/Citations).
Use Shadcn UI for standard inputs, dropdowns, dialogs, and toast notifications (Sonner). Strip away default styles to match the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' dark theme.
Implement responsive design: hide right sidebar on tablet, hide left sidebar on mobile (use hamburger menu).
Citations MUST be clickable and trigger the right sidebar to highlight or scroll to the specific reference.
Make sure to include 'data-testid' on all buttons, links, and forms for testing.
Ensure the Chat UI input bar supports multi-line text and handles Enter to submit (Shift+Enter for new line).
For rendering Markdown and Code Blocks in AI responses, use libraries like 'react-markdown' and 'react-syntax-highlighter'.
